text:
Maya: Heads up — Dr. Elena Park (BioLogix) is coming by today around 15:00 with a demo box that might be bulky. She said she'll check in at the front desk. Can someone confirm we can hold the package and have a place to stage it? :package:

FrontDeskBot: New delivery logged for 'Dr. Elena Park / BioLogix' — oversized, signature required. Front desk note: locker A12 too small, will stage on cart near reception. Photo uploaded. :pushpin:

Liam: I can cover the front desk from 14:30–17:00 today, happy to accept it. Where's the loading-bay key / gate code kept?

Maya: Loading bay key is in the red cabinet (labelled "loading keys"). Gate code is 0427 — please keep it internal. Also FYI Jenna's shift ends at 14:30 so the swap is set. :door:

Noah: If it's a demo that needs setup, happy to reserve Meeting Room 3 for 15:15. I'll bring a dolly and a couple of chairs.

Sofia: Quick note — the badge printer is low on laminates. We can do temporary sticker badges if needed. @people-ops should we restock or use stickers today? :id_card:

Ava: There's a small stash of temporary sticker badges in drawer 2 of the supply closet — front desk can use them. Also, please remind visitors to take packaging with them or we'll put it in the parcel area.

Maya: Perfect, thanks. @Liam can you confirm you saw the FrontDeskBot entry and will accept the delivery? @Noah please book MR3 if it works. I'll ping Dr. Park to confirm a 14:50 check-in window so we have time to stage. :thumbsup:

Liam: Confirmed — I see the bot entry and will take it. I'll meet the courier at the loading bay.

FrontDeskBot: Shift swap recorded: Jenna 09:00–14:30, Liam 14:30–17:00. Delivery status: staged on reception cart.

Maya: Awesome — thanks everyone. If anything changes ping this thread.
